text: Agtonomy - About the company Agtonomy is a series B company based in San Francisco (United States), founded in 2021 by Tim Bucher. It operates as an AI-driven automation solutions for agriculture and industrial equipment. Agtonomy has raised $64M in funding from investors like Momenta, Flybridge Capital Partners and Bobcat. The company has 66 active competitors, including 15 funded and 10 that have exited. Its top competitors include companies like Oxa, Overland and Clearpath Robotics. Company Details AI-driven automation solutions for agriculture and industrial equipment. It provides AI-driven automation to help growers tackle labor shortages, improve efficiency, and manage rising costs. They embed intelligence into industrial equipment, turning machines into powerful tools. Their technology delivers precision, safety, and efficiency in tough environments. They offer solutions for automating routine tasks like mowing and hauling, using trusted equipment on both diesel and electric platforms. The company provides a unified command experience for managing diverse equipment and job types. Their user-friendly app allows users to create plans, monitor progress, and gain insights through performance reports. They focus on practical solutions that boost productivity, sustainability, and progress across industries. They offer AI, robotics, and real-world operations expertise to empower operators with tools that make work safer, smarter, and more sustainable.
